questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: Yesterday I ____ my uniform.
questions.explanation: Yesterday shows the past, so the verb takes -ed: washed. Wash is for now, and washing needs a helping verb like was.

questions.prompt: Which words tell you that a sentence is about the past?
questions.explanation: Last week has already gone. Tomorrow and next year are still to come.

questions.prompt: What is the past simple of 'study'?
questions.explanation: Study ends in a consonant and y, so y changes to -ied: studied.

questions.prompt: What is the past simple of 'stop'?
questions.explanation: A short verb that ends in one vowel and one consonant doubles the last letter: stopped.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: She did not ____ football yesterday.
questions.explanation: After did not, use the plain verb: did not play. Did already shows the past, so we do not add -ed again.
Yesterday needs the past simple: cleaned. Clean is the present, and cleaning cannot stand alone.
